records.reason: it is valid to use SSI Aeration, Inc. AFD270E nine inch EPDM fine bubble disc diffusers for ongoing and future maintenance and capital improvements

records.part: disc diffusers for secondary treatment aeration basins
records.reason: it is valid to use SSI Aeration, Inc. disc diffusers for secondary treatment for all Regional Water Recycling Plants: RP-1, RP-4, RP-5, and CCWRF
RP-1 utilizes Parkson panel diffusers that are no longer supported by the manufacturer and are expected to reach the end of service life in 2027.
CCWRF uses Parkson Flex A Tube diffusers, an older technology with potentially limited future availability.
